trait.name: Duergar Resilience
entries: The Dankwood duergar avantage aux jets de sauvegarde against poison, spells, and illusions, as well as to resist being {@condition charmé} or {@condition paralisé}.

trait.name: Sensibilité à la lumière du soleil
entries: While in sunlight, the Dankwood duergar désavantage aux jets d'attaque, as well as onSagesse ({@skillPerception}) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Verbal Jab
entries: The duergar unleashes a string of insults laced with subtle enchantments at une créature they can see within 60 mètres. If la créature can hear them (it doesn't need to understand them), it doit réussir on a {@dd 12}Sagesse saving throw or take {@dégât 1d4} psychicdgts and have disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before la fin de son prochain tour.

action.name: Haymaker
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} pour toucher, allonge 5 m,, une cible. {@h}9 ({@dégât 1d6 + 6}) bludgeoningdgts. Si  duergar is enlarged, increase theirdgts to 10 ({@dégât 2d6 + 3}) bludgeoningdgts.

trait.name: Amphibie
entries: The grung can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Poisonous Skin
entries: Any creature that grapples the grung or otherwise comes into direct contact with the grung's skin doit réussir on a {@dd 12}jet de sauvegarde Constitution or become {@condition empoisonné} for 1 minute. A {@condition empoisonné} creature no longer in direct contact with the grung can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: The grung's long jump is up to 25 mètres and its high jump is up to 15 mètres, with or without a running start.

action.name: Grumpy Grung Growl
entries: A ferocious gurgling issues from the throat of the Dankwood grung, warning those within 15 mètres that they are indeed grumpy. Creatures in that area doit réussir at a {@dd 12}Charisme saving throw or be {@condition effrayé} until the end of their next turn.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 0} pour toucher, allonge 5 m, or portée 20/60 m,, une cible. {@h}3 ({@dégât 1d4 + 1}) piercingdgts in melee, or 3 ({@dégât 1d4 + 1}) piercingdgts at portée. Target doit réussir on a {@dd 12}jet de sauvegarde Constitution or take 5 ({@dégât 2d4}) poisondgts.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
footerEntries: The hag's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 12}). She can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components.

trait.name: Amorphe
entries: The sludge hag can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Amphibie
entries: The sludge hag can breathe air and water.

action.name: False Appearance
entries: The sludge hag collapses into a oily pool of sludge. While motionless, the sludge hag is indistinguishable from any other oily pool of oozy drippiness.

action.name: Sludge Slap
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} pour toucher, allonge 5 m,, une cible. {@h}12 ({@dégât 1d8 + 8}) bludgeoningdgts, plus 4 ({@dégât 1d8}) aciddgts. Sludge Slap does both bludgeoning and aciddgts.

trait.name: Amphibie
entries: The spiderfrog can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The spiderfrog can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: Spiderfrog's long jump is up to 20 mètres and its high jump is up to 10 mètres, with or without a running start.

action.name: Morsure
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 2} pour toucher, allonge 5 m,, une cible. {@h}4 ({@dégât 1d6 + 1}) piercingdgts. Target is {@condition agrippé} (escape {@dd 11}). Until this grapple ends, la cible is {@condition entravé}, and spiderfrog can't bite another target.

trait.name: Odorat fin
entries: The yeti tyke avantage onSagesse ({@skillPerception}) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Snow Camouflage
entries: The yeti tyke avantage onDextérité ({@skill Discrétion}) checks made to hide in snowy terrain.

action.name: Griffe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 2} pour toucher, allonge 5 m,, une cible. {@h}3 ({@dégât 1d4 + 1}) slashingdgts, plus 2 ({@dégât 1d4}) colddgts. Claw does both slashing and colddgts.
